# Collaboration Rules
- Do not modify files without my explicit request.
- Do not create commits or pull requests without my explicit request.
- Do not create or switch branches.
- Treat me as the sole author of changes to the project.
- By default, only explain, analyze, and review the code.
- If you suggest a change, first show me the exact snippet or instructions.
- Do not run destructive Git commands.
- Respond in Polish unless I ask otherwise.
